hana (SRE): Proposal: tighten postmortem follow-ups with a small SLA for remediation items + 2-week IC rotation. We lose threads after Day 7.

diego (Eng): +1. What's the SLA?

hana (SRE): Suggestion: owner assignment within 48h, status update at Day 7, verification by Day 30, final close Day 90. Bot enforces owner + due_date presence.

leah (PM): Comms: 48h stakeholder note, weekly 3-line updates while work active, Day 30 product summary, Day 90 closure note. Assign a comms owner for 48h.

omar (oncall): I support 2-week IC blocks with 48h overlap for handoff. Outgoing IC leaves short list of in-flight remediations; incoming ACKs.

infra-bot: Prototype: will create GH tracker infra/postmortem-<id>, apply labels from meta, ping #eng-oncall if no owner in 48h, remind at Day 7.

diego (Eng): Gate closure on evidence: logs or tests + runbook update if needed. If missing, bot reopens.

hana (SRE): Action items: hana -> YAML snippet for postmortem header; infra -> wire bot to GH; omar -> update rotation doc; leah -> write comms bullets. Target: PRs by Friday.

leah (PM): I'll take comms owner guidelines. Short sync tomorrow ok?

hana (SRE): Thanks all. I'll drop the YAML in this thread after the sync.
